capabilities: Export a canvas to a self-contained HTML file
Inline images as data URIs and render embedded notes one level deep
Preserve pan and zoom navigation in the exported file
Configure output folder, image size limits, and default theme
disambiguation: It exports an existing canvas to HTML; it does not create, edit, or view canvases inside Obsidian.
extras: The manifest carries an unreleased-plugin warning ('This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.'), and the README documents known limitations such as Mermaid diagrams exporting as source code and embeds followed only one level deep.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share a canvas as a standalone file that people without Obsidian can open and interact with.

relations.evidence: Add sam080626-arch/obsidian-canvas-to-html as a beta plugin in BRAT.

summary: Canvas exporter that converts an Obsidian Canvas into a single self-contained HTML file with pan, zoom, and rendered note content.
